reason: Tauri 2.12.4 and tungstenite 0.28 still resolve digest 0.10, which requires block-buffer 0.10.4. The issue requires a caller-controlled compression callback to panic, catch the panic, and reuse the corrupted buffer; BatCaverna only reaches fixed SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations whose compression callbacks do not panic. Remove this exception when Tauri and tungstenite adopt digest 0.11/block-buffer 0.12.1.
